reviews.text: Hi, James. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Very helpful, friendly also a very good environment
Very happy with the level of care my dog received. He was very unwell after eating a bone and was able to be seen promptly and given the care and attention he needed.

My dog had her first ever seizure in front of Nora at the clinic and she did absolutely nothing about it. No referrals or medication. We had to ask to be referred to a speciality clinic (cause she took no action) where we discovered my dog had an infection that spread to her brain. Add this to the fact that a consultation here is not cheap, so we payed for her to do nothing.

We attended the clinic today with our bulldog, the service and treatment was fantastic!! We see a vet called Nora who was knowledgeable, professional and efficient. The clinic is welcoming and spotlessly clean, we was really impressed that we was able to get the blood results on the same day. We can’t thank them enough and will 💯 use them again if needed in the future.

Waggin' Tails looked after my boy (and me) last year through cancer surgery. Their clinic is very calming, and friendly, and the team are extremely understanding towards pet owners. Outstanding service 👏🏽 👌🏽 👍🏽 …

For the grooming and shop side - they are _amazing_!  Always great service (even when short staffed, shared with the veterinary next door), friendly, accommodating, and with the pet's comfort in mind.  Our dog (Mabel) hates the process but loves the people (and the outcome)!  Fantastic choice of food, supplements,  toys / distractions, and all sundries.  Highly recommended!
Friendly, efficient.

The team at this clinic is amazing! They are always caring, supportive, and genuinely dedicated to providing the best care for my cats. Every visit has been professional and reassuring. Strongly recommend!
Easy contact and appointment. Treatment worked well and follow-up was good. In general a good experience

Always very caring for the best of the pets.
Dr Nora is very professional and knowledgeable. Claire is extremely friendly and helpful.
Highly recommend this practice. I have three pets.

My wife, Raquel Albieri, and I are very happy with the care of our Charlotte for 5 consecutive years! And we are very grateful!
Pedro.
Excellent vets.  Good booking service.  Late hours too.
amazing experience and good qualified vets. They’re very polite

Just back from having my cats claws trimmed .A completely different experience here , Nurse Claire was so gentle and careful with poor stressed Foxie and job was done  in a twink . No upselling or pressure just a simple job done at a fair price . I will be recommending this practice to all the animal owners I know !
Great Vet and receptionist, helped with the government certificate for our move to the UAE, very friendly, efficient and highly recommended!
Dr Nora and Claire make for the best team in SW London! Friendly, attentive, and consistently right the first time they've treated any of my cats. Highly recommended.

Fantastic clinic. Friendly, professional staff who always consider the best interests of both pet and owner. Very transparent (& fair) pricing, genuinely care for their customers. My dog loves her visits here, is treated with so much care, and despite having had operations that required me to drop her off and leave her, is not afraid to go back - which shows how well she has been looked after.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Waggin’ Tails Veterinary Clinic! My dog, a big, lovable bear, has been a patient here for roughly four years, and the care he’s received has been nothing short of outstanding.

From the moment we walk through the door, we’re greeted with warmth and genuine kindness. Nora and her assistant Claire are nothing short of exceptional. They’ve always gone above and beyond to make both me and my dog feel completely at ease. Whether it’s a routine check-up, advice on care, or addressing any health concerns, their professionalism, knowledge, and compassion shine through every time.

Nora has an incredible ability to connect with animals, and you can tell she truly loves what she does. Her attention to detail and thorough explanations always leave me feeling confident that my dog is in the best hands. And Claire, what a gem! Her friendly and inviting nature makes every visit a pleasure.

Over the years, Waggin’ Tails has become more than just a vet clinic, it feels like family. I trust them completely with my furry friend’s health, and I’m so grateful for the outstanding care they provide. If you’re looking for a team that truly cares about your pet as much as you do, I couldn’t recommend Waggin’ Tails enough. Thank you, Nora and Claire, and the whole team for keeping my big bear happy, healthy, and thriving!

I used to look after a black cocker spaniel (Darcy).
The 1st time we went he tried to jump the gate to get back to me but the other times he was more relaxed and when he stayed with me I booked him  for 2 hours day care because I had a long dental appointment.

The dentist asked why I didn't leave him at home
I replied so he had company.

When I collected him Claire told me he was good.  It's obviously that Claire loves dogs and cats.

Best groomer in SW6 area. Not the cheapest, not to say actually very expensive, but so worth it. I got positive comments from people on the street about his grooming and this has never happened previously. Not to mention that other groomers …

We’ve been with WTCV for 3 years now and we’re SO happy and grateful for them! Friendly staff, very professional vet service and Baloo (our 4 yr Border Collie) always wagged his tail coming in! Thank you for everything :)

The store itself is great, lots of dog toys, treats and everything you could want/need. However I took my dog Lana here in June 2017 for a haircut and when I went to collect her, the receptionist returned me someone else's Labradoodle. I …
Nothing is too much trouble - even with a difficult dog. Many many thanks, we are very grateful for the care and kindness shown.

This is a fantastic place ... I always bring my Pomeranian boy named Max for almost 5 years ago; since he was puppy till now.  I am glad & satisfied with the job the staff doing with my boy, specially lulu made for him wonderful work ... …
